title: I-026 template editor session and graphics-library store
clauseOfficialized: Private graphics-library/1 store (not project user_version 9) with immutable versions and heads. Same Graphic@1 stays pinned in P and Q after @2; only Q's explicit upgrade moves. Deleting a head leaves pinned versions loadable; pinned versions are GRAPHIC_IN_USE. Unauthorized material cannot enter a shared template; selection does not grant redistribution. Empty/too-long names are refused; tags are casefold-deduped; search is namespace-first. TemplateEditorSession rebinds a photo without flattening or changing text/ids/transforms; a required empty slot may stay as a draft and blocks delivery; unknown template metadata refuses upgrade/rebind.
whyNotAlreadyOfficial: Increment 2.15 landed ten official layered templates but left the graphics-library store and template-edit UI unopened.
